about_the_game:
Draw a line through a live puzzle of falling letters, survive wave after wave, and avoid colliding with the boss. Each wave you survive unlocks capsules containing mysterious lion-dogs called Mainus.

This demo is capped at wave 75 — but don’t worry, reaching it is extremely challenging. You’ll be able to collect up to 26 Mainus here. In the full version, there will be over 200 to discover.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel UHD 600 or better, Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or Apple M1/M2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: A simple yet brutal puzzle game. Draw lines through letter puzzles, complete waves, and face powerful bosses. Unlock capsules to collect mystical dogs known as Mainus—but what secrets do they hold? Reaching 100 waves is humanly impossible… or is it?
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
